issue.body: When I run the build in watch mode on Linux, the process exits after the first rebuild instead of watching. It worked fine on 2.3.0 and broke after upgrading to 2.4.1. I tried raising the inotify limit, clearing the cache and reinstalling, but nothing changed. The same project works on macOS with the same version.
